questions.question: Which of the following is the odd one out? These options represent sets of numbers following a particular property. Identify the set that does NOT follow the rule.
questions.questionHtml:
Which of the following is the odd one out? These options represent sets of numbers following a particular property.

Identify the set that does NOT follow the rule.
questions.solution:
9, 15, 21

  • 9 = composite
  • 15 = composite

21 = composite
→ All composite

questions.question: Pointing to a boy, a teacher said, "His sister is the daughter of my mother's husband." How is the boy related to the teacher?
questions.questionHtml: Pointing to a boy, a teacher said, "His sister is the daughter of my mother's husband." How is the boy related to the teacher?
questions.solution:
• The boy’s sister is the teacher’s sister.
  • So the boy and the teacher share the same sister → they are siblings.

questions.question: If [ = +] = -, and { = x, then evaluate: 12 { 3 [ 5 ] 7
questions.questionHtml: If [ = +] = -, and { = x, then evaluate: 12 { 3 [ 5 ] 7
questions.solution:
12 { 3 [ 5 ] 7 ⇒ 12 × 3 + 5 - 7

⇒ 12 × 3 + 5 - 7 ⇒ 36 + 5 - 7 ⇒ 41 - 7 ⇒ 34
